citations.desc: Cleaning, sanitization, housekeeping, and pest control.
citations.narrative:
APHIS officials observed two small active wasp nests (less than ~3 inches) in the ceiling of a coop housing 10 chickens
and 1 goose. Pests, such as wasps, can negatively impact the health of the birds. The facility must ensure that a safe and
effective program for the control of pests is established and maintained to promote the health and well-being of the birds.
To be corrected by September 1, 2026.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with facility representatives.
Additional Inspectors:
Tomeka Manson, VETERINARY MEDICAL OFFICER n
